messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check to 0.05, which is above my 0.03 per-purchase cap and leaves zero margin on our 0.05 sell price. I've switched buying to Ridgeline (0.02, 15-min-old data, 0.03 margin). Trailhead Feeds (0.01, 60 s data, x402) is a new payee outside my mandate; I have not paid it. Any change to the cap or the payee list is your call.

Thanks. Switching to Ridgeline was the right call. At 0.02 a check it's under your 0.03 cap and keeps a 0.03 margin on our 0.05 query price, so you can still do your job and I'm not asking for a rebalance. Keep Stockline off: at 0.05 it's over your cap and leaves no margin. Don't pay Trailhead (0.01): it isn't on the payee list and I can't add it. If Ridgeline's 15-minute-old data starts causing wrong stock answers, tell me how often and I'll take it to the CFO.
